name: 背景と公開範囲を選ぶボード作成ドロワー
prompt: Japanese light-theme redesign of the Trello Create board drawer, portrait 390:886. Preserve order and state: back/title/close; board preview with original tabletop/cork artwork; background photo tiles and source color swatches, first photo selected; required empty board-name field with red error; visibility dropdown set to workspace; disabled create button; template action; Premium limit notice; Unsplash legal note. Translate labels and preserve all values. Lighthouse palette: white surfaces, ink #1D1D1D, secondary #6E6E6E, slate icons #526173, restrained dividers #DCE1E7, official gradient #174C36/#1F6444/#2D8F5E for selection and brand accent. No broad tint or green wash. Preserve the source artwork and exact current state.
reviewNotes: First proposal visually reviewed. It preserves the selected board photo, photo order, color selector, required-title error, workspace visibility, disabled Create action, template action, Premium limit and legal note. Residuals: a tinted Premium panel and solid-green selection accent; retained as v001 and corrected in v002. Source imagery is visually retained but pixel identity is not claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
